TransactionSecurityPolicy.customEmailContent:
{{event.Username}} tried to export a report that exceeds the 10,000 row limit. Use this event information to start your investigation.


  • Organisation ID - {{policy.OrganizationId}}
  • User ID - {{event.UserId}}
  • User Name - {{event.Username}}
  • Report ID - {{event.ReportId}}
  • Rows Processed - {{event.RowsProcessed}}
  • Event Date - {{event.EventDate}}
  • Description - {{event.Description}}
  • Dashboard ID - {{event.DashboardId}}
  • Dashboard Name - {{event.DashboardName}}
  • Source IP - {{event.SourceIp}}

Additional Information

  • Displayed Field Entities - {{event.DisplayedFieldEntities}}
  • Event Name - {{event.Name}}
  • Event Source - {{event.EventSource}}
  • Format - {{event.Format}}
  • Is Scheduled - {{event.IsScheduled}}
  • Name - {{policy.MasterLabel}}
  • Name of Columns - {{event.ColumnHeaders}}
  • Name of Grouped Columns - {{event.GroupedColumnHeaders}}
  • Number of Columns - {{event.NumberOfColumns}}
  • Operation - {{event.Operation}}
  • Owner ID - {{event.OwnerId}}
  • Queried Entities - {{event.QueriedEntities}}
  • Policy Type - {{policy.Type}}
  • Scope - {{event.Scope}}
  • Session Level - {{event.SessionLevel}}
TransactionSecurityPolicy.description: When a user exports more than 10000 rows of data, an email notification is to be triggered.
